name: The Austin Chronicle editorial board
lean_basis: AllSides rates The Austin Chronicle Left (independent review, low or initial confidence, as of Oct. 2026). No separate rating for its editorial board was found.

name: Austin American-Statesman editorial board
lean_basis: AllSides' current page rates the Austin American-Statesman Center (independent review, low or initial confidence, as of Aug. 2026); an older duplicate page that still lists its former owners says Lean Left. Neither rates the editorial board.

name: KUT News (Austin's NPR station)
lean_basis: Public radio newsroom that does not endorse; it describes its guides as 'Non-partisan voter guides that help Central Texans stay civically engaged and make informed decisions' (https://www.kut.org/about). No outside rating found, so it is shown as not rated.

name: Community Impact Newspaper
lean_basis: AllSides lists Community Impact as Not Rated. Free local newspaper chain that does not endorse; its stated mission is 'to build communities of informed citizens and thriving businesses' (https://communityimpact.com/about/). No outside rating found, so it is shown as not rated.

name: League of Women Voters Austin Area
lean_basis: League of Women Voters chapter that says it is nonpartisan, 'neither supporting nor opposing candidates or political parties at any level of government' (https://lwvaustin.org/). No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.

name: Travis County Democratic Party
lean_basis: Official county party organization.

name: Travis County Republican Party
lean_basis: Official county party organization. Posts support for specific nominees and the Prop I petition; no full local guide found for Nov 2026.

name: Stonewall Democrats of Austin
lean_basis: LGBTQ Democratic club that says 'National Stonewall Democrats support the Democratic Party and Democratic candidates who support our mission' (https://www.stonewallaustin.org/). No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.

name: Central Austin Democrats
lean_basis: Democratic club; the Travis County Democratic Party lists 'Central Austin Democrats' among its Democratic clubs (https://www.traviscountydemocrats.org/democratic-clubs). No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.

name: Black Austin Democrats
lean_basis: Democratic club; the Travis County Democratic Party lists 'Black Austin Democrats' among its Democratic clubs (https://www.traviscountydemocrats.org/democratic-clubs). No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.

name: Austin Environmental Democrats
lean_basis: Democratic club; the Travis County Democratic Party lists 'Austin Environmental Democrats' among its Democratic clubs (https://www.traviscountydemocrats.org/democratic-clubs). No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.

name: Austin Firefighters Association (IAFF Local 975)
lean_basis: Firefighters' union (IAFF Local 975); its international union calls itself 'a union that is proud to fight for you, your family, and your community' (https://www.iaff.org/local/975). No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.

name: Austin Police Association
lean_basis: Police union whose stated mission, 'To Support And Advocate For All Members Of The Austin Police Association, Their Families And Austin’s Diverse Community' (https://www.austinpolice.com/about), uses no ideological language. No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.

name: Austin EMS Association
lean_basis: EMS workers' union that says it works to 'empower medics to advocate for a rewarding, safe, and healthy career with strong benefits' (https://www.austinemsa.org/about). No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.

name: Austin Central Labor Council (AFL-CIO)
lean_basis: AFL-CIO labor council that calls itself 'dedicated to represent the interests of working people at the state and local level' (https://austinlaborcouncil.org/about-us). No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.

name: Workers Defense Action Fund
lean_basis: Political arm of Workers Defense Project, which describes its work as 'building power with latine workers in Texas for immigrant and worker justice' (https://workersdefense.org/en/). No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.

name: AURA
lean_basis: Volunteer urbanist group 'dedicated to building an Austin with abundant affordable homes in walkable neighborhoods' (https://aura-atx.org/about/), with more transit, bike lanes and sidewalks. No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.

name: Austin Board of REALTORS (TREPAC)
lean_basis: Real estate trade group that calls itself 'the largest real estate trade organization in Central Texas' (https://www.abor.com/about). No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.

name: Real Estate Council of Austin
lean_basis: Commercial real estate group that calls itself 'the premiere policy and networking professional group for commercial real estate in Central Texas' (https://www.reca.org/). No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.

name: Austin Apartment Association PAC
lean_basis: Landlord trade group that calls itself 'a trade association serving anyone who owns or manages rental property' (https://www.austinaptassoc.com/). No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.

name: Greater Austin Chamber of Commerce
lean_basis: Regional chamber of commerce whose stated mission is 'To provide leadership that facilitates the creation of a prosperous regional economy and results in effective advocacy for our members' (https://www.austinchamber.com/about). No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.

name: Save Austin Now PAC
lean_basis: Prop I campaign group whose site is headed 'Audit Austin City Spending' (https://www.saveaustinnow.com/), with pages on property taxes and government waste. No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.

name: Travis County Taxpayers Union
lean_basis: Anti-tax group (its name states its cause). Its website, traviscountytaxpayers.org, did not resolve on Oct. 17, 2026, so no mission statement could be quoted. No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.

name: Austin Democratic Socialists of America
lean_basis: Self-described socialist group: 'We’re the Austin chapter of the Democratic Socialists of America' (https://www.austindsa.org/). No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.
